sources.title: MPOINT Magnetic Point Group Tables
sources.role: standard magnetic point-group numbers and traditional Hermann-Mauguin symbols

sources.title: Teaching crystallographic and magnetic point group symmetry using three-dimensional rendered visualizations

conventions.magnetic_number: parent crystallographic point-group number.local magnetic type.global number (1-122)
conventions.time_reversal: false for a unitary spatial operation and true for the same operation composed with time reversal
conventions.construction: type I: G; type II: G + theta G; type III: H + theta(G-H), where H is an index-two subgroup
conventions.setting: inherits the toolkit canonical Cartesian embedding of the parent crystallographic point group
